headline: Howmet Aerospace (HWM) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump After Analysts Lift Q2 Views
summary: Price targets for Howmet Aerospace are now clustering in the low to mid US$300s, with updated fair value estimates moving from US$311.68 to US$325.93. Analysts link this shift to recent Q2 model updates and rising confidence in the company’s earnings power, while still weighing growth, margin and valuation risks.
